description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] if 0-3 FF4 allies are alive, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (8s)] if 4+ FF4 allies are alive, grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Airship Tech], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Buff Lightning 20% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Airship Tech
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Bolt Rush after using Lightning abilities

description.name: Bolt Rush
description.text: Six single ranged attacks (0.72 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Buff Lightning 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 20%, cumulable
